aboutGame.title: What is Pax Autocratica?
paragraphs: The official site frames Pax Autocratica as a satirical totalitarian colony sim crossed with an FPS roguelite. Its advertised loop moves from shaping a population and building the state apparatus to expeditions and combat.
The current identity is the Multiverse game on Steam App ID 1067360. Platform and release details can change, so the linked primary pages are the source of truth for access and updates.

seo.title: Pax Autocratica Gameplay Guide
seo.description: Understand the published Pax Autocratica colony-building, automation, expedition, and combat loop before starting a run.

pages.direct_answer: The documented loop is to shape the population, build and automate the state apparatus, then take the frontier expeditions into FPS roguelite combat.

sections.heading: Start with the colony
paragraphs: Population shaping is part of the official pitch, so treat people, policy, and production as connected systems rather than isolated menus.

sections.heading: Build the apparatus
paragraphs: The official site highlights building and automation. A first plan should therefore identify the state infrastructure you need before leaving for the frontier.
steps: Shape the population and identify the immediate constraint.
Build the state apparatus and automate the repeatable work.
Prepare for an expedition and switch to the combat layer when the frontier calls.

sections.heading: Keep the boundary clear
paragraphs: This page describes the published design, not a promise about every Early Access implementation detail. Check current updates before treating a mechanic as final.

faq.question: Is the game only a colony sim?
faq.answer: No. The official positioning combines a colony sim with an FPS roguelite and explicitly connects the colony loop to frontier expeditions and combat.
